name: Capabilities Introduction Call
description: Capture what was presented, what the client needs, and where a follow-up may create value.

sections.title: Client Context and Needs
sections.instruction: Summarize the client's situation, priorities, needs, and constraints.

sections.title: Capabilities and Proof Presented
sections.instruction: List capabilities, examples, credentials, and proof claims presented.

sections.title: Questions and Objections
sections.instruction: List client questions, objections, responses, and unanswered questions.

sections.title: Potential Fit
sections.instruction: List fit hypotheses and interest signals, clearly distinguishing explicit statements from interpretation.

sections.title: Requested Materials
sections.instruction: List materials, examples, or introductions requested.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: List agreed next steps with owners and dates when stated.
